name: android-compose-inspector
description: Inspect live Jetpack Compose recomposition and skip counts without Android Studio.

interface.shortDescription: Track live Compose recompositions from Codex.
interface.longDescription: Attaches the official Android UI Inspector agent to a debuggable app and gives Codex live Compose hierarchy, recomposition, skip, bounds, and source-location data without opening Android Studio.
defaultPrompt: Attach to my Compose app and track recompositions.
Show the composables recomposing most often.
Watch recompositions while I reproduce a UI issue.
